purpose: Reproduce public aggregate exposure arithmetic; no individual PK model, brain prediction, efficacy or advancement decision.

pba.molecular_weight_basis: free acid, not sodium salt, phenylacetate or glycerol prodrug
pba.clinical_context: Adult UCD randomized crossover HPN-100-006; 44 completers; repeated 24-hour plasma sampling after 14 days of each formulation at PBA-equivalent maintenance treatment. Aggregate parent-PBA AUC values, not the ammonia efficacy endpoint or raw participant curves.
pba.binding_boundary: External in-vitro protein-binding range; illustrative fixed-fraction sensitivity only, not measured free AUC, a confidence interval or a bound on every patient. Binding may vary over time and concentration.
pba.culture_reference_boundary: An assumed maintained 100 uM reference over 24 hours; the paper does not measure this concentration-time integral, free-medium fraction or intracellular profile. Do not multiply clinical AUC by 14 or claim equivalent temporal exposure.

elamipretide.location: FDA Table 7, printed page 26 / PDF page 95
elamipretide.context: SPISC-102; five healthy volunteers; matched steady-state summaries after seven days of 40 mg subcutaneous once-daily treatment. These study details describe published observations, not a proposed dose.
elamipretide.boundary: Ratio of group mean peak times interval to group mean measured AUC. No concentration-time curve is reconstructed; a peak held constant is an invented reference, not observed exposure. No between-drug efficacy comparison follows.
